limits: Exact directEnemy source krakenTentacle, CEL enKrakenTentacleNew(Clone), motion renderer krakenTentacle and source renderer 121595 only. This archive grants no inheritance to krakenTentacleMirror, a Sea King tentacle, krakenHead or another renderer topology.

The ordinary zero-focus attack used the native bluntSmithHammer without a skill cap or damage fixture and produced native Damaged for 8 HP, from 162 to 154. The disposable party maximum-HP fortification remained active for test survival and is not representative hero balance.

The native pass action records AttackCrit and Tentacle_Attack2_M on the exact enemy renderer while hero HP changes from 999 to 989. This is sampled native enemy gameplay under the survival fixture, not a balance claim.
The explicit KillSingle fixture reduced enemy HP from 154 to 0 with recorded native 1000 damage and a Death trigger. It is fixture death evidence, not ordinary lethal gameplay.

The source has m_DoRagdoll false with zero rigidbodies. Death is animator-driven: Tentacle_Death is observed from retained frames 30 through 89, followed by an inactive, not-visible renderer and disabled animator at retained frame 90.

Pass and ordinary attack each retain all requested 120 frames. The death capture retains an accepted 91-frame prefix and terminates because the renderer is destroyed before the next requested sample. Exact identity is stable in all 331 retained frames; this boundary does not establish full death duration, cleanup causality, corpse lifetime or final disposal.
Strict Ready succeeded at dungeon level 0, room 2, with one active Ready button. No Collect action was taken and this archive makes no Collect claim.

Seventeen selected original PNGs were reviewed. Native effects, combat UI, foreground overlap and fixed-camera cropping limit fine inspection in stated frames; the remaining 314 capture PNGs are preserved by hash but were not individually reviewed.

The profile preserves native CEL scale 1.0 and a Standard matKraken1 material using the authored texture with emission disabled and no emission map. This route does not establish portrait pixels, other cameras, other resolutions, collision or all-angle culling.

This isolated dungeon trial does not prove every Kraken animation, alternate materials, long-session resource lifetime, inheritance to another Kraken source, full campaign progression or finished-art acceptance.
